documents.name: rule-0.md
documents.text: 订单锁定必须在15分钟后自动解除.

documents.name: rule-1.md
documents.text: 身份验证必须核对员工工号.

documents.name: rule-2.md
documents.text: 订单取消必须立即释放库存.

documents.name: rule-3.md
documents.text: 信用评价必须在7天内提交.

documents.name: rule-4.md
documents.text: 申诉处理必须保留审核记录.

documents.name: rule-5.md
documents.text: 隐私保护必须隐藏联系电话.

documents.name: rule-6.md
documents.text: 商品限制不得允许危险物品.

documents.name: rule-7.md
documents.text: 支付确认必须核对订单金额.
